implemented: Versioned profile envelope with payload checksum
Separate local .office-agent-profiles.json state records generated file hash, prior description and configuration path
Upgrade checks separate state against actual bytes, parsed identity, previous registration and envelope before replacement
Generated description changes use literal bounded substitution plus complete semantic TOML preservation check
Local state participates in path checks, snapshots, backups and rollback
Legacy profiles recognized only by exact equality to current generated marked or unmarked payload; divergence blocks with manual reconciliation guidance

Added regression coverage for ordinary upgrades, read-only checks, preservation, envelope tampering, self-rehash without matching state, wrong identity, legacy migration, invalid state, state hardlinks and partial-upgrade rollback

limitations: Local state and checksums identify accidental/customized divergence; they are not signatures and cannot authenticate against an actor controlling the entire CODEX_HOME.
Legacy divergent profiles without matching prior state require explicit backup and manual reconciliation; there is no forced adoption option.
Unusual customized registration formatting blocks description replacement rather than rewriting unrelated TOML.
Existing trusted/quiescent filesystem assumption, Windows ACL limitation and best-effort multi-file rollback limitation remain unchanged.
No live host apply, agent execution, existing-chat reload, documentation acceptance, independent QA/Security approval or production readiness is attested here.
